## Exons

```{r blast-exons}
exon_cmd <- sprintf(
  paste(
    'blastn -task megablast -query %s -subject %s',
    '-max_hsps 50',
    '-outfmt "6 qseqid sseqid pident length mismatch gapopen',
    'qstart qend sstart send evalue bitscore qlen slen"'
  ),
  shQuote(genomic_path), shQuote(cdna_path)
)

col_names <- c("Query", "Subject", "Identity", "Aln.Length",
               "Mismatches", "Gaps", "Q.start", "Q.end",
               "S.start", "S.end", "E.value", "Bit.score",
               "Q.len", "S.len")

exon_out <- system(exon_cmd, intern = TRUE)
exon_hits <- if (length(exon_out) > 0) {
  read.table(text = exon_out, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
             col.names = col_names)
} else {
  data.frame()
}

cat(sprintf("Exons found: %d HSPs against the cDNA\n", nrow(exon_hits)))
```
